newsitem.title: INDONESIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sona Topas rated a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sona Topas rated a "buy".

text.p: Indonesia brokerage PT Peregrine Sewu Securities rated tourist operator PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry a "buy" on Thursday following a rapid expansion of its duty free shop network.
"Aggresive duty free store openings will have a profound impact on overall margins (of Sona Topas). This will fuel 39 percent compound earnings growth through 2001," Peregrine said.
Peregrine said it expected the company to book a net profit of 21.40 billion rupiah in 1997 and 39.34 billion and 48.31 billion rupiah in 1998 and 1999 respectively.
The company plans to add four stores to its 18-strong network by end 1998, including the world's largest duty free shop in Bali.
Peregrine said Sona Topas should be valued as a retail stock as it was transforming itself into a high-growth retailer from a travel and ticket agency.

The brokerage said currently Sona Topas holds 60 percent of Indonesia's duty free market, including prime locations in all major international airports and is well-placed to take advantage of robust growth in tourist arrivals over the next five years.
Peregrine said based on a 1998 price/earnings ratio of 6.8 times, the stock is still cheap, given balance sheet strength and strong earnings growth prospects.
"The re-rating should continue as Sona Topas is valued more as a retail play than a pure travel and leisure play," the report said. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
